name: Kylee O'Donnell
reason: Mainly a flutist and musician rather than a teacher: her YouTube is almost all flute music (often titled for stress, grief or sleep) and her most-viewed video is her own 'New Age to Jesus' testimony renouncing her former psychic and manifestation work, so a Spiritpedia listing would misrepresent her; what remains is one beginner flute course, one sound bath and a private-events enquiry form.
